import Mathlib

def seq_u64_to_int (xs : List Nat) : List Nat := xs

def is_valid_robbery (houses : List Nat) (len : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, i < houses.length → houses.getD i 0 < len) ∧
  (∀ i, i < houses.length - 1 → houses.getD (i+1) 0 ≥ houses.getD i 0 + 2)

def total_loot (houses : List Nat) (values : List Nat) : Nat :=
  houses.foldl (fun acc i => acc + values.getD i 0) 0

-- Precondition definition
@[simp, reducible]
def rob_precond (nums : List Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  nums.length ≤ 100 ∧
  ∀ i, i < nums.length → nums.getD i 0 ≤ 10000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

noncomputable section

def prependAll (i : Nat) : List (List Nat) → List (List Nat)
  | [] => []
  | xs :: xss => (i :: xs) :: prependAll i xss

def extendWith (base : List (List Nat)) : Nat → List (List Nat)
  | 0 => []
  | k + 1 => extendWith base k ++ prependAll k base

def allLists (n : Nat) : Nat → List (List Nat)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | len + 1 => allLists n len ++ extendWith (allLists n len) n

def robberyCandidates (nums : List Nat) : List (List Nat) := by
  classical
  exact (allLists nums.length nums.length).filter
    (fun houses => is_valid_robbery houses nums.length)

def bestOf (values : List Nat) : List (List Nat) → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | houses :: rest => max (total_loot houses values) (bestOf values rest)

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function (dynamic programming solution)
def rob (nums : List Nat) (h_precond : rob_precond nums) : Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  bestOf (seq_u64_to_int nums) (robberyCandidates nums)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definition
@[simp, reducible]
def rob_postcond (nums : List Nat) (result : Nat) (h_precond : rob_precond nums) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ houses : List Nat,
      is_valid_robbery houses nums.length →
        total_loot houses (seq_u64_to_int nums) ≤ result) ∧
    (∃ houses : List Nat,
        is_valid_robbery houses nums.length ∧
          total_loot houses (seq_u64_to_int nums) = result)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

lemma mem_prependAll {i : Nat} {xs : List Nat} {base : List (List Nat)} :
    xs ∈ base → i :: xs ∈ prependAll i base := by
  induction base with
  | nil =>
      intro h
      cases h
  | cons y ys ih =>
      intro h
      simp [prependAll] at h ⊢
      cases h with
      | inl hxy =>
          subst xs
          exact Or.inl rfl
      | inr hrest =>
          exact Or.inr (ih hrest)

lemma mem_extendWith {base : List (List Nat)} {i n : Nat} {xs : List Nat} :
    i < n → xs ∈ base → i :: xs ∈ extendWith base n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro hi _
      omega
  | succ n ih =>
      intro hi hxs
      by_cases hlt : i < n
      · have hm : i :: xs ∈ extendWith base n := ih hlt hxs
        simp [extendWith, hm]
      · have hieq : i = n := by omega
        subst i
        have hm : n :: xs ∈ prependAll n base := mem_prependAll (i := n) hxs
        simp [extendWith, hm]

lemma nil_mem_allLists (n len : Nat) : ([] : List Nat) ∈ allLists n len := by
  induction len with
  | zero =>
      simp [allLists]
  | succ len ih =>
      simp [allLists, ih]

lemma mem_allLists_of_getD {n len : Nat} {xs : List Nat}
    (hlen : xs.length ≤ len)
    (hget : ∀ i, i < xs.length → xs.getD i 0 < n) :
    xs ∈ allLists n len := by
  revert xs
  induction len with
  | zero =>
      intro xs hlen hget
      cases xs with
      | nil =>
          simp [allLists]
      | cons x xs =>
          have hbad : xs.length + 1 ≤ 0 := by
            simpa using hlen
          omega
  | succ len ih =>
      intro xs hlen hget
      cases xs with
      | nil =>
          exact nil_mem_allLists n (len + 1)
      | cons x xs =>
          have hx : x < n := by
            have h := hget 0 (by simp)
            simpa [List.getD] using h
          have hlen' : xs.length + 1 ≤ len + 1 := by
            simpa using hlen
          have hxs_len : xs.length ≤ len :=
            Nat.succ_le_succ_iff.mp hlen'
          have hxs_get : ∀ i, i < xs.length → xs.getD i 0 < n := by
            intro i hi
            have h := hget (i + 1) (by simp [hi])
            simpa [List.getD] using h
          have htail : xs ∈ allLists n len := ih hxs_len hxs_get
          have hnew : x :: xs ∈ extendWith (allLists n len) n :=
            mem_extendWith (base := allLists n len) (i := x) (n := n) hx htail
          simp [allLists, hnew]

  simp [is_valid_robbery]

lemma valid_index_le_getD {houses : List Nat} {len : Nat}

    ∀ i, i < houses.length → i ≤ houses.getD i 0 := by

  induction i with
  | zero =>
      intro _
      exact Nat.zero_le _
  | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      have hi_len : i < houses.length := by omega
      have hi_gap : i < houses.length - 1 := by omega
      have hgap := hvalid.2 i hi_gap
      have hih := ih hi_len
      omega

    houses.length ≤ len := by
  by_cases hzero : houses.length = 0
  · omega
  · let i := houses.length - 1
    have hi : i < houses.length := by
      dsimp [i]
      omega
    have hlt : houses.getD i 0 < len := hvalid.1 i hi
    have hle : i ≤ houses.getD i 0 :=
      valid_index_le_getD (houses := houses) (len := len) hvalid i hi
    have hlen_eq : houses.length = i + 1 := by
      dsimp [i]
      omega
    omega

    ∀ {cands : List (List Nat)} {houses : List Nat},
      houses ∈ cands → total_loot houses values ≤ bestOf values cands := by
  intro cands
  induction cands with
  | nil =>
      intro houses hmem
      cases hmem
  | cons a rest ih =>
      intro houses hmem
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at hmem
      cases hmem with
      | inl h =>
          subst houses
          exact Nat.le_max_left _ _
      | inr h =>
          exact le_trans (ih h) (Nat.le_max_right _ _)

lemma bestOf_exists (values : List Nat) (cands : List (List Nat)) :
    ∃ houses : List Nat,
      (houses = [] ∨ houses ∈ cands) ∧
        total_loot houses values = bestOf values cands := by
  induction cands with
  | nil =>
      refine ⟨[], ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · simp [bestOf, total_loot]
  | cons a rest ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨houses, hmem, heq⟩
      by_cases hle : total_loot a values ≤ bestOf values rest
      · refine ⟨houses, ?_, ?_⟩
        · cases hmem with
          | inl h =>
              exact Or.inl h
          | inr h =>
              exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem a h)
        · have hmax :
              max (total_loot a values) (bestOf values rest) = bestOf values rest :=
            Nat.max_eq_right hle

            total_loot houses values = bestOf values rest := heq
            _ = bestOf values (a :: rest) := by
              rw [bestOf, hmax]

          Nat.lt_of_not_ge hle

        · exact Or.inr (by simp)
        · have hmax :
              max (total_loot a values) (bestOf values rest) = total_loot a values :=
            Nat.max_eq_left hge
          rw [bestOf, hmax]

-- !benchmark @end lemma

theorem rob_postcond_satisfied (nums : List Nat) (h_precond : rob_precond nums) :
    rob_postcond nums (rob nums h_precond) h_precond := by
